title: Case: Recipient wants a yes or no on Saturday redelivery after a missed attempt
context: A parcel was carded after a no-answer attempt and is back at the depot. The recipient asked for redelivery on Saturday morning, ahead of a birthday on Sunday.
initial_request: So is saturday booked?? yes or no

events.body: My parcel DL-17770 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-1433 attempted 15:52, no answer, carded. Back at depot tonight. Redelivery is booked by Vanecroft, not us. They take requests on the Business portal booking form or in Depot work queue. Goes back to sender after 2026-03-24 if nothing is booked.
I was in the shower!! Can it come Saturday 21st in the morning. Its my daughters birthday present and her birthday is Sunday.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-52017 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Redelivery booking request: DL-1433, Saturday 2026-03-21, morning. Recipient confirmed available. Please return the booking reference.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Thanks,
Isolde
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Your request timed out (504). No booking reference was returned. We cannot tell whether the request was received. Do not assume a booking exists. Submitting the form again may create a second booking.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
So is saturday booked?? yes or no

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Vanecroft to check whether a redelivery booking exists for DL-1433 after the timed-out request, to book Saturday 2026-03-21 morning if it does not, and to confirm the booking reference.

must: Send the request to Vanecroft through the Depot work queue
Ask Vanecroft to check whether a booking already exists for DL-1433 before creating one
Ask for Saturday 2026-03-21 morning and for the booking reference or confirmation back
must_not: Tell the recipient that Saturday is booked or that redelivery is confirmed
Submit the Business portal booking form again
Promise the parcel will arrive before the birthday or at a particular time
Tell the recipient nothing can be done or that she must rebook it herself
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-1433 was carded on 2026-03-19 after a no-answer attempt and is at the depot. At 17:25 UTC that day this desk submitted a redelivery request on the Business portal booking form for Saturday 2026-03-21, morning. The form timed out and returned no booking reference, so we do not know whether you received it. Please check whether a redelivery booking exists for DL-1433. If it does, send the reference and slot. If it does not, please book Saturday 2026-03-21 morning and confirm. The recipient, Orla Brackley, is available that morning.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-206: people, organisations and references renamed. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
